meta.note: Single source of truth for Mini Nectar tokens. tokens.css is generated from this file (python3 scripts/build_tokens.py) and the Claude Design artifact publishes this same file. Light values follow hb-mininectar; dark values are the production Nectar values from hummingbird-rails.

tokens.name: ui-bg
tokens.usage: The base surface: cards, tables, modals, any panel that holds content. Ground for ui-text, ui-text-secondary and ui-text-tertiary.

tokens.name: ui-bg-secondary
tokens.usage: The page behind the panels, and quiet section bodies such as table headers and toolbars. Ground for ui-text and ui-text-secondary.

tokens.name: ui-bg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled field backgrounds and pressed states on quiet controls. Never put body copy on it — only ui-disabled labels.

tokens.name: ui-bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Anything floating over the page: modals, dropdowns, popovers, toasts. Always paired with shadow-overlay or shadow-floating.

tokens.name: ui-border
tokens.usage: Dividers, table rules, card outlines — structure the eye reads past. Decorative only; not a control edge.

tokens.name: ui-border-secondary
tokens.usage: The edge of an interactive control: inputs, selects, textareas, checkboxes, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ui-disabled
tokens.usage: Text and icons in a disabled control, on ui-bg-tertiary. Deliberately below 4.5:1 — a disabled control is exempt, and the low contrast is the signal.

tokens.name: ui-disabled-soft
tokens.usage: The fill or border of a disabled control — a disabled toggle track, an unchecked disabled checkbox.

tokens.name: ui-text
tokens.usage: Primary copy, headings, table cell values. On ui-bg and ui-bg-secondary. 21:1 light, 17.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: ui-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, supporting copy. On ui-bg and ui-bg-secondary. 7:1 light, 8.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: ui-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, help text, timestamps — the quietest text that still has to be read. On ui-bg: 4.6:1 light, 6.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: ui-text-knockout
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a saturated fill: primary buttons (ui-interaction), danger buttons (ui-status-danger), avatars. Never on ui-bg.

tokens.name: ui-icon
tokens.usage: The default ink of a standalone icon, on ui-bg and ui-bg-secondary. An icon inside a button or link inherits that control's color instead.

tokens.name: ui-icon-secondary
tokens.usage: Decorative or secondary icons sitting beside tertiary text — field affordances, quiet row glyphs.

tokens.name: ui-interaction
tokens.usage: The brand's one action color: primary button fills, checked checkboxes and radios, focus rings, active nav. 4.6:1 with ui-text-knockout.

tokens.name: ui-interaction-highlighted
tokens.usage: Hover and press on anything filled with ui-interaction.

tokens.name: ui-interaction-contrast
tokens.usage: The readable end of the blue ramp: text or icons on ui-interaction-soft, and deep avatar backgrounds. 9.4:1 on ui-interaction-soft in light.

tokens.name: ui-interaction-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted blue ground: the focus halo around a control, selected table rows, blue tags. Carries ui-interaction-contrast, never ui-text-knockout.

tokens.name: ui-interaction-link
tokens.usage: Inline and standalone links on ui-bg. Darker than ui-interaction in light so link text clears 4.5:1 (5.3:1 light, 6.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: ui-status-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive button fills, invalid control borders, error icons. With ui-text-knockout on the fill.

tokens.name: ui-status-danger-text
tokens.usage: Error messages and invalid field help text on ui-bg. Separate from ui-status-danger because dark mode has to lighten the red to stay readable.

tokens.name: ui-status-danger-highlighted
tokens.usage: Hover and press on a danger button.

tokens.name: ui-status-danger-contrast
tokens.usage: Text and icons inside an error alert or a red tag, on ui-status-danger-soft.

tokens.name: ui-status-danger-soft
tokens.usage: The ground of an error alert, toast or tag. Pair only with ui-status-danger-contrast.

tokens.name: ui-status-success
tokens.usage: Success icons and confirmation button fills. With ui-text-knockout on the fill.

tokens.name: ui-status-success-contrast
tokens.usage: Text and icons inside a success alert or a green tag, on ui-status-success-soft.

tokens.name: ui-status-success-soft
tokens.usage: The ground of a success alert, toast or tag.

tokens.name: ui-status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning icons and markers. A light yellow: never carries ui-text-knockout — put ui-status-warning-contrast on it.

tokens.name: ui-status-warning-contrast
tokens.usage: Text and icons inside a warning alert or a yellow tag, on ui-status-warning-soft (7.9:1 light).

tokens.name: ui-status-warning-soft
tokens.usage: The ground of a warning alert, toast or tag.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-blue
tokens.usage: Categorical blue for tags, charts and entity colors. Same hue as ui-interaction — use the expressive name when the color means a category, not an action.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-blue-contrast
tokens.usage: Label on a blue tag, on ui-expressive-blue-soft.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a blue tag or chart fill.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-green
tokens.usage: Categorical green — credits, approvals, positive entities.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-green-contrast
tokens.usage: Label on a green tag, on ui-expressive-green-soft.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-green-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a green tag or chart fill.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-red
tokens.usage: Categorical red — debits, flags, high-risk entities.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-red-contrast
tokens.usage: Label on a red tag, on ui-expressive-red-soft.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-red-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a red tag or chart fill.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-yellow
tokens.usage: Categorical yellow. Light enough that it only ever carries its own contrast token, never knockout text.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-yellow-contrast
tokens.usage: Label on a yellow tag, on ui-expressive-yellow-soft.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-yellow-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a yellow tag or chart fill.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-purple
tokens.usage: Categorical purple — institutions, and one end of the AI gradient.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-purple-contrast
tokens.usage: Label on a purple tag, on ui-expressive-purple-soft.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-purple-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a purple tag or chart fill.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-pink
tokens.usage: Categorical pink — devices, and the other end of the AI gradient.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-pink-contrast
tokens.usage: Label on a pink tag, on ui-expressive-pink-soft.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-pink-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a pink tag or chart fill.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-orange
tokens.usage: Categorical orange — businesses, products.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-orange-contrast
tokens.usage: Label on an orange tag, on ui-expressive-orange-soft.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-orange-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an orange tag or chart fill.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-brown
tokens.usage: Categorical brown — the quietest hue in the set, for low-salience categories.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-brown-contrast
tokens.usage: Label on a brown tag, on ui-expressive-brown-soft.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-brown-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a brown tag or chart fill.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-light-blue-contrast
tokens.usage: Label on a light-blue tag. This hue exists only as a tag pair — there is no base value.

tokens.name: ui-expressive-light-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a light-blue tag.

styles.name: hb-text-heading
styles.usage: Page and panel titles. The largest type in the product — Hummingbird does not scale headings up.

styles.name: hb-text-heading-small
styles.usage: Section titles inside a panel. Same size as body, separated by weight alone.

styles.name: hb-text-body
styles.usage: The default. Body copy, table cells, form values, button labels.

styles.name: hb-text-body-bold
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy, and the value half of a label/value pair.

styles.name: hb-text-caption
styles.usage: Field labels, help text, timestamps, metadata. Usually in ui-text-secondary.

styles.name: hb-text-caption-bold
styles.usage: A caption that has to be found — tag labels, counts, small column headers.

styles.name: hb-text-all-caps
styles.usage: Group headings above a list or nav section. Set in uppercase with tracking-1; use sparingly, never for a sentence.

spacing.note: A 4px base. 2px exists only for optical nudges inside a control.

tokens.name: spacing-2
tokens.usage: Optical nudges inside a control — the gap between a tag's icon and its label.

tokens.name: spacing-4
tokens.usage: Gap between tightly bound items: an icon and its label, a field and its help text.

tokens.name: spacing-8
tokens.usage: The workhorse. Gap between buttons in a row, between a toggle and its label, padding inside a compact table cell.

tokens.name: spacing-12
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside inputs, selects and buttons; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: spacing-16
tokens.usage: Padding inside cards, alerts, modal bodies; gap between form groups.

tokens.name: spacing-24
tokens.usage: Padding of a page panel; gap between sections inside one panel.

tokens.name: spacing-32
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections.

tokens.name: spacing-40
tokens.usage: Page gutters on wide layouts.

tokens.name: spacing-48
tokens.usage: Space above a page's first panel.

tokens.name: spacing-56
tokens.usage: Rare large separation — an empty state's breathing room.

tokens.name: spacing-64
tokens.usage: Rare large separation.

tokens.name: spacing-72
tokens.usage: Rare large separation.

tokens.name: spacing-80
tokens.usage: The largest step — the top of a marketing-weight or onboarding page.

tokens.name: border-radius-4
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, textareas, checkboxes, tooltips — anything you type into or tick.

tokens.name: border-radius-8
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, dropdowns, alerts, toasts.

tokens.name: border-radius-16
tokens.usage: Modals only. The one shape that says 'this is on top of everything'.

tokens.name: border-radius-round
tokens.usage: Fully round: avatars, tags, floating actions, toggle tracks, loaders.

shadow.note: Three layers, no more. Elevation is carried by shadow plus ui-bg-overlay, never by a border.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Attached overlays: dropdown menus, popovers, the multiselect menu.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Detached surfaces: modals, toasts, the peeking sidenav.

tokens.name: shadow-action
tokens.usage: Floating actions only — the one shadow on a control rather than a surface.

fontSize.note: Three sizes. The scale is deliberately flat: hierarchy comes from weight and color.

tokens.name: font-size-12
tokens.usage: Captions, labels, tags, all-caps group headings.

tokens.name: font-size-14
tokens.usage: The default size for everything readable: body, controls, table cells.

tokens.name: font-size-16
tokens.usage: Headings, and the minimum for a field the user types into on touch.

tokens.name: font-weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body copy and captions.

tokens.name: font-weight-bold
tokens.usage: Headings, button labels, control text, emphasis. Hummingbird's 'bold'.

tokens.name: font-weight-bolder
tokens.usage: Section titles and strong emphasis, where 500 is not enough separation.

tokens.name: line-height-default
tokens.usage: Headings, and any single line that should sit tight.

tokens.name: line-height-ui
tokens.usage: Body copy, captions, control labels — everything that may wrap.

tokens.name: tracking-none
tokens.usage: Every style but all-caps. Inter needs no tracking at these sizes.

tokens.name: tracking-1
tokens.usage: All-caps group headings only.

iconSize.note: Material Icons, sized in three steps. The icon is always optically centered with the text beside it.

tokens.name: icon-size-sm
tokens.usage: Dense controls: small buttons, table row actions, tag glyphs.

tokens.name: icon-size-md
tokens.usage: The default: buttons, inputs, nav items, alerts.

tokens.name: icon-size-lg
tokens.usage: Prominent or standalone actions, and empty-state glyphs.
